summary: Recent updates to the OpenGL and GL contexts within Firefox focused on improving compatibility and performance when rendering graphics, particularly when using EGL/ANGLE, which allows OpenGL to run on different platforms like Windows and macOS. Notably, **this update enhances the way Firefox utilizes IOSurfaces for better integration on macOS**, ensuring smoother graphics handling. Additionally, adjustments were made to eliminate unnecessary syncing processes across different threads, reduce library loading issues on macOS, and fix existing mathematical bugs related to graphics transformations. These improvements collectively enhance the browser's ability to deliver high-quality visuals for web applications and games.
